title: A bad config never blocks startup: back up, repair, continue
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Invalid JSON or unknown/deprecated keys must not fail startup: keep a timestamped backup, fall back to derived defaults, and print what was done. Tests zc_config_selfheal_*.
